[[Murakai's Reaver]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[axe]] obtained from [[Murakai's Chest]], which spawns after defeating [[Murakai, Lady of the Night]] in the [[Cathedral of Flames]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 6-28 (Requires 9 [[Axe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Stygian Reaver]], [[dye]]d black.
